function.name: execute_bash

#include <string.h>
#include <stdio.h>
int main(void){
    char *p;
    {
        char tempBuf[12];
        tempBuf[0]='X'; tempBuf[1]=0;
        p = tempBuf;
    }
    // read after scope
    printf("%c\n", p[0]);
    return 0;
}
EOF



gcc -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -fsanitize-address-use-after-scope -O1 -o /tmp/uaf /tmp/uaf.c 2>&1 | head
